text: .aee/infrastructure-inventory.json — Infrastructure Analyzer output; top-level keys: dockerfiles, terraform, kubernetes; each is an empty array when no infrastructure files are found in the repository

.aee/infrastructure-findings.json — Infrastructure Analyzer output; JSON array of configuration findings (unpinned images, runs-as-root, privileged containers, etc.); empty array when no infrastructure files present

.aee/infrastructure-summary.md — human-readable Infrastructure Analyzer summary: Infrastructure Inventory section, Configuration Findings section, Secrets Detected counts (values redacted), Notes section

src/payload_plaintext/aurora-portal/ — aurora-portal Python Django service; 17 modules (api, adapter, collector, dispatcher, formatter, indexer, maintenance, notifier, publisher, quota, region_lookup, resolver, session, telemetry_consumer, throttle, validator) plus tests; no Dockerfile, Kubernetes manifests, or Terraform files accompanying it in the repository
